customManagers.description: The images of the package builds, pinned by digest in the matrix of packages.yml.

packageRules.description: Crates: minor and patch updates together. Cargo.lock is kept to versions that build with rust-version (resolver 3), which Renovate never changes.
ignore 0.4.30 needs Rust 1.88 and does not declare it. Remove this rule together with the limit in the Cargo.toml files when rust-version is 1.88.
aya 0.14 needs Rust 1.87, and Debian 13 has 1.85. Remove this rule together with the limit in keyboard-state/Cargo.toml when rust-version is 1.87.
Actions: a new version is not taken before it has been out for three days.
The base images of the package builds, of the local containers and of the container of the aports job, pinned by digest: the updates of tags and digests together in one pull request.

The tag of a package build image is the distribution release that the job builds for, and the job is named after it: Renovate updates only its digest by itself. A new tag (a new release) is only listed on the Dependency Dashboard, as a sign to add an entry of its own to the matrix; the old release stays until its support ends.
